    Test plan - Vida Verde

    General Information

    • Project: Vida Verde

    • Test environment: Inicio | Vida Verde

    • Release / Versión: Equipo 2 - Gardening Online Store | Releases | 1.0UnreleasedVista previa

    • Test Manager: Cristina Hernández, Teresa Mercader, Soraya Cazorla, Judit Casamitjana

    Test Objectives

    • Validate the website functionalities corresponding to this version.

    • Ensure that the recent changes have not introduced errors in existing functionalities.

    Test Scope

    • Devices and browsers:

      • Desktop: Chrome.

      • Mobile: iPhone 12 Pro

    • Functionalities to test:

      Clave Resumen Descripción
      SCRUM-24 SHOPPING CART

      User Story:
      As a user,
      I want to have a shopping cart,
      so that I can view my order.

      Acceptance Criteria:

      • There will be a shopping cart icon in the menu that will open the Shopping Cart page.
      • The user can add products to the cart from the Products page. When a product is added to the cart, the name, image, category, and price of the added product will appear on the Shopping Cart page.
      • The user can remove products from the cart in two ways: from the Product page or from the Shopping Cart page. When a product is removed from the cart, it will disappear from the Shopping Cart page.
      • When there are products in the cart, the following will appear:
      1. Purchase summary, which will include:
      • The total price of the added products.
      • The 21% VAT amount.
      • The shipping cost, which will be €5.
      • The total purchase amount, which will be the sum of the products plus VAT plus shipping.
      • When products are added to or removed from the cart, the price must update automatically.
      1. A "Clear cart" button that will empty the Shopping Cart page. It will only be available when there are products in the cart.
      2. A "Continue shopping" link that will open the Products page so the user can keep adding products to the cart.
      • When the cart is empty, a "View products" button will appear that will open the Products page.
      SCRUM-23 COMPLETE PURCHASE

      As a user,
      I want to complete the purchase of my order.
      So that I can successfully go to order completed page.

      Acceptance Criteria:

      When there are products in the cart, a Proceed to Payment button will appear, which will take the user to the Place Order page. This page will include:

      Order Summary:

      • Product names with their prices.
      • Subtotal: sum of the prices of all products.
      • VAT 21%: total VAT applied.
      • Shipping: €5.
      • Total: sum of all amounts.

      Shipping and Payment Form:

      The form must include the following required fields and buttons:

      • Full Name (required).
      • Email (required).
      • Address (required).
      • Valid Card Number (required). Valid test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242.
      • Back to Cart button, which returns to the cart page.
      • Complete Purchase button:
        • If any form field is incorrect, an error message will be displayed.
        • If all data is correct, an Order Completed page will appear including:
          • Order summary with product names and prices. Subtotal. VAT 21%. Shipping €5 and Total.
          • Back to Store button, which opens the products page.
          • Go to Home button, which opens the home page.
      SCRUM-22 ABOUT US PAGE

      As a customer

      I want to see an “About Us” page

      So that I can learn more about the store

      Acceptance Criteria:

      • The page includes a “About Us” title.
      • The page includes information about the store’s history and values.
      • The page displays a picture of the team.
      • It must be responsive.
      SCRUM-21 HOME PAGE

      As a customer

      I want to see a home page

      So that I can view the store’s relevant information

      Acceptance Criteria:

      • A title with the store’s name is displayed.
      • A description is displayed.
      • There is an image of the store.
      • There is a button to open the store’s products page.
      • It must be responsive.
      SCRUM-20 NAVIGATION MENU

      As a customer

      I want to see a menu with links to Home, About Us, Products, and Contact

      So that I can easily navigate the site

      Acceptance Criteria:

      • The menu displays the links: Home, About Us, Products, and Contact.
      • Each link navigates to its corresponding section.
      • The menu is visible on all pages.
      • It must be responsive.
      SCRUM-19 CONTACT PAGE

      As a user
      I want to have a contact form
      So that I can communicate with the store

      Acceptance Criteria:

      The form includes the following fields:

      1. Name (required).
      2. Email (required), with a valid email format.
      3. Phone (optional), with a valid phone format (numbers only or with a + prefix).
      4. Message (required, maximum 500 characters).

      A confirmation message is displayed upon successful submission.
      Validation messages are shown if there are errors.
      The page must be responsive.
      SCRUM-18 PRODUCT FILTER

      As a user
      I want to filter products
      So that I can easily find the one that fits my needs

      Acceptance Criteria:

      1. Filter by name: The system must display products whose name contains the entered text.
      2. Filter by price: The user can filter by minimum price, maximum price, or a price range (minimum and maximum). The system must display products within the specified range.
      3. Filter by category: Plants, tools, or pots. The system must display products from the selected category.
      4. Filters can be combined with each other.
      5. If no matches are found, an informative message must be displayed.
      6. When at least one filter is active, the user can remove all filters using the “Clear Filters” option.
      7. When filters are cleared, the full unfiltered list of products must be displayed.
      8. If no filters are applied, the option to clear them must not be available.
      SCRUM-17 OUR PRODUCTS

      As a plant-loving buyer
      I want to see plants organized by category, name, and price
      So that I can more easily find what I am looking for.

      Acceptance criteria:

      1. The page displays the title
      2. A list of products is displayed with the following information:

      -category

      -name

      -price

      1. The page must be responsive.

    Entry Criteria

    • User stories must be deployed in the testing environment.

    Exit Criteria

    • All functional tests have been executed.

    • There are no critical open defects.

    • All regression tests have been passed.

    Test Types

    • Functional tests: for each user story included in the release.

    • Regression tests: before each release and after every change, to ensure that existing functionalities have not been affected.

    • Exploratory tests: before each release, to detect errors not foreseen by the formal test cases.

    Responsibilities

    • QA: designs and executes the tests, reports defects, and documents the results.

    • Development: implements the functionalities and fixes the detected defects.

    Tools and Test Data

    • Test management: AssertThat.

    • Bug reporting: JIRA.

    • Automation: Playwright.

    • Test data:

      • Test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242

    Communication and Reporting

    • All defects are managed in JIRA.

    • The summary of results and detected defects is documented in Confluence.

    Test Results

    • Executed functional test results: Functional Test Results (Github) / Funcional Tests Results (JIRA)

    • Executed regression test results: Regression Test Execution Results (Playwright Automation)

    Bug Report

    All defects detected during functional, regression, and exploratory testing were recorded.

    SCRUM-50 clear all active filters is not working

    On the product catalog page, when the user has multiple filters applied and selects the "Clear Filters" option, all filters should be removed. However, while category, price, and other filters are cleared correctly, the name filter remains active and continues to restrict the product list.

    Expected Behavior

    • When the user clicks "Clear Filters":
      • All active filters should be removed, including the name filter.
      • The product catalog should display all products with no filters applied.

    Steps to Reproduce

    1. Navigate to the product catalog page.
    2. Apply several filters, including the name filter.
    3. Click on "Clear Filters".
    4. Observe that the name filter remains active and the product list does not reset fully.

    Actual Result

    • The category, price, and other filters are cleared correctly.
    • The name filter remains applied.
    • The product list continues to show filtered results based on the name value.
    • The catalog does not return to the full, unfiltered product list.

    Expected Result

    • All filters, including the name filter, should be completely removed when the user selects "Clear Filters".
    • The product catalog should display all available products with no filters applied.
    • The UI should reflect a fully reset filter state

    Additional Information

    error occurs in both mobile and desktop version
    SCRUM-49 The total on the complete order page is incorrect

    Given I am on the "Order complete" page
    Then I should see an Order Summary section
    And I should see product names with their prices
    And I should see the Subtotal as the sum of all product prices
    And I should see VAT calculated at 21% of the Subtotal
    And I should see Shipping cost as "€5"

    Actual result:

    And I see the Total as the sum of Subtotal, VAT, and Shipping as 79.83€

    Expected result:

    And I should see the Total as the sum of Subtotal, VAT, and Shipping as 81.83€
    SCRUM-47 Filter products by a minimum and maximum price range is not working

    During the regression test, the price range filter in the catalog (minimum and maximum price) is not functioning correctly. When entering both a minimum and a maximum price, no products are displayed, even though there are items whose prices fall within the specified range.

    Steps to Reproduce

    • Open the catalog page.
    • Open the price filter dropdown.
    • Enter a minimum price value.
    • Enter a maximum price value.
    • Apply the filter.
    • Observe the results.

    Actual Result

    No products are shown, even when the catalog contains items that fall within the selected price range.

    Expected Result

    Products with prices within the specified range (greater than or equal to the minimum and less than or equal to the maximum) should be displayed.

    Additional Information

    error occurs in both mobile and desktop version
    SCRUM-45 Maximum price filter in catalog is not working version chrome computer

    During the regression test, the maximum price filter in the catalog is not functioning correctly. When entering a maximum price in the dropdown field, no products are displayed, even though there are items priced below or equal to the specified maximum value.

    Steps to reproduce:

    • Open the catalog page.
    • Click on the price filter dropdown.
    • Enter a maximum price value.
    • Apply the filter.
    • Observe the results.

    Actual Result

    No products are shown, even when the catalog contains items that match the maximum price entered.

    Expected Result

    Products with a price equal to or lower than the entered maximum value should be displayed.
    SCRUM-44 Filter products by a minimum price

    During the regression test, the minimum price filter in the catalog is not functioning correctly. When entering a minimum price in the dropdown field, no products are displayed, even though there are items that meet or exceed the specified minimum price.

    Steps to Reproduce

    1. Open the catalog page.
    2. Click on the price filter dropdown.
    3. Enter a minimum price value.
    4. Apply the filter.
    5. Observe the results.

    Actual Result

    No products are shown, even when the catalog contains items that match the minimum price entered.

    Expected Result

    Products with a price equal to or higher than the entered minimum value should be displayed

    Additional Information

    error occurs in both mobile and desktop version
    SCRUM-43 Filter products by minimum price

    During the regression test, the minimum price filter in the catalog is not functioning correctly. When entering a minimum price in the dropdown field, no products are displayed, even though there are items that meet or exceed the specified minimum price.

    Steps to reproduce:

    • Open the catalog page.
    • Click on the price filter dropdown.
    • Enter a minimum price value.
    • Apply the filter.
    • Observe the results.

    Actual Result

    No products are shown, even when the catalog contains items that match the minimum price entered.

    Expected Result
    Products with a price equal to or higher than the entered minimum value should be displayed.
    SCRUM-40 Combined Filters Not Working on Plant Catalog Page

    Summary

    When applying multiple filters on the plant catalog page (name, minimum price, maximum price, and category), the system returns no products or displays products that do not match the selected filters. The filtering logic does not behave as expected.

    Version chrome and version iphone 12 pro

    Steps to Reproduce

    1. Open the plant catalog page.
    2. Locate the filters for name, minimum price, maximum price, and category.
    3. Apply the following values:
      • name: "rose"
      • minPrice: 10
      • maxPrice: 20
      • category: Plants
    4. Submit or apply the filter.

    Actual Result

    • No products are displayed even when matching products exist, or
    • Products appear that do not satisfy the selected filters. The filtering logic is not correctly combining the criteria.

    Expected Result

    Only products that match all selected filters simultaneously should be displayed. This means products whose:

    • Name contains "rose",
    • Price is between 10 and 20,
    • Category is Plants.
    SCRUM-38 Error Price Filter not working on plants catalog page version escritorio

    Summary

    The price range filter on the plant catalog page is not functioning correctly. When the user enters both a minimum price and a maximum price, the list of plants either shows no results or displays plants outside the specified price range.

    Version chrome and version iphone 12 pro

    Steps to Reproduce

    1. Open the plant catalog page.
    2. Locate the price filter with minimum and maximum price fields.
    3. Enter a valid minimum price (e.g., 10).
    4. Enter a valid maximum price (e.g., 30).
    5. Apply the filter.

    Actual Result

    • Sometimes no plants are displayed even though there are plants within the specified range.
    • Other times, plants outside the price range appear in the results.
    • The filter does not consistently apply the price constraints.

    Expected Result

    Only plants with a price between the minimum and maximum values (inclusive) should be displayed.
    SCRUM-36 Error filter by max price

    The maximum price filter on the plant catalog page does not work as expected. When the user enters 30 as the maximum price, the list does not update to show only plants priced at 30 or below.

    version chrome and version iphone 12 pro

    Steps to Reproduce

    1. Open the plant catalog page.
    2. Locate the Maximum Price filter input.
    3. Enter 30 into the filter field.
    4. Observe the list of displayed plants

    Actual Result

    Plants with prices above 30 are still shown, and the filter does not update the list correctly.

    Expected Result

    Only plants with a price of 30 or less should be displayed. Plants priced above 30 should be hidden.

    Additional Information:
    Error occurs in desktop and mobile.
